bluf: France 24 reported that two Libyan soldiers died from injuries in a Ukraine-claimed attack on Russian ships near Benghazi; Al Jazeera reported that Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army vowed retaliation. France 24 reported that Yemen’s Houthis claimed attacks on Riyadh’s financial district and the Ras Tanura refinery, saying they were retaliation for strikes on their territory.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that attackers have actively exploited a critical Drupal vulnerability to hijack unpatched sites since at least Thursday, citing confirmation from the Drupal security team.

items.text: France 24 reported that two Libyan soldiers died from injuries sustained in a Ukraine-claimed attack on Russian ships near Benghazi; Al Jazeera reported that Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army vowed retaliation.
BBC News World reported that leaked Russian figures show almost 500,000 people lost in the Ukraine war and reveal changed mortality patterns in Russia.
France 24 reported that Yemen’s Houthis claimed attacks on Riyadh’s financial district and the Ras Tanura refinery, in retaliation for strikes on their territory.
Reuters reported that the Houthis threatened Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah is attacked, while a coalition reported strikes.
Al Jazeera reported that the Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi attacks after a strike on Hodeidah.
BBC News World reported that Colombian police freed around 20 shoppers and employees held hostage in a supermarket after 17 hours; one gunman was killed in the operation.
